confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on aggregated Egypt and Cairo cost-of-living figures from mixed-date sources (2023 to July 2026). No Aswan-specific price series was found, and tourist-facing pricing in Aswan may run above Cairo levels. Beer and cocktail anchors are the least certain: beer was taken from Cairo-area and national figures, and the cocktail was set as roughly three times beer because direct cocktail data was not found. Wine is estimated from the same beer-relative basis, with added uncertainty because wine is scarce and priced irregularly in Aswan. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Upper Egypt tourist-town context, without any accommodation search or inspection of live listings. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure found (20 March 2026). A newer RBA observation could not be confirmed, so the rate may be stale for a November 2026 generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on national Egypt and Cairo mid-range restaurant and beer price points, adjusted upward for a Nile tourist town. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Aswan's Nile-front and budget hotel and hostel stock, not a comparison to a specific city.
